title: Genesis 22:2 — Take your son, your only son, whom you love
summary: Genesis 22:2 in English: God tells Abraham to take his only son Isaac, whom he loves, to the land of Moriah and offer him as a burnt offering. The word “love” is drawn with a heart and marked with a superscript 1, the first time love appears in the Bible.

text.text: 2 He said, “Take now your son, your only son, whom you lo♥e¹, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.”

numbers.note: superscript on “love” — first mention of love in the Bible

uncertain: The superscript 1 after “love” is not explained on the slide; it most likely marks the first occurrence of “love” in the Bible.
